description.value: Travellers Motel is a 12-room motel in Cranbrook, BC, winner of a 2022 Traveller Review Award, offering standard and kitchen-equipped rooms alongside an on-site launderette and BBQ facilities. Situated 7 minutes from the airport, it lies close to the Mara Trail and within easy reach of Fort Steele and the Canadian Museum of Rail Travel. Its central East Kootenay location makes it a practical overnight base for cyclists passing through or exploring the region.
